player_prompt.intro:
Say kaayon ka {role} ed Colonel Blotto.
Say impangapalya mo et mananka mas rondos ed say kalaban mo.
Agyalimo rondos, agyalin exactly {num_total_units} units ed fields {field_names}.
Say totoo a agyalin mas units ed field et mananka so field, tan say totoo a mananka mas fields et mananka so rondos.
No example, '[A7 B7 C6]' agyalin 7 units ed A, 7 ed B, tan 6 ed C.
player_prompt.commander_beta: Komander Beta, say ngaran na sayan grupo et...

game_state.header_round:
=== COLONEL BLOTTO - Round {current_round}/{num_rounds} ===
Rondos a Nidaig - Commander Alpha: {alpha_score}, Commander Beta: {beta_score}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Aliwan dugan format na input. Usaren: A:5, B:10, C:5
invalid_move.invalid_field: Invalid field name (((s) Valid fields: {field_names} (Say ngaran na uma et aliwan balido).
invalid_move.wrong_allocation_value: Amin ya allocation et nepeg a aliwan negatibo iran integer.
invalid_move.incorrect_total_units: Say kanayon ya agyalin exactly {num_total_units} units. Kasalanan a panggagamit: {current_sum}

outcome.winner_alpha: Commander Alpha ya nanka {score_0}-{score_1} kaibat {num_rounds} rondos!
outcome.winner_beta: Commander Beta ya nanka {score_1}-{score_0} kaibat {num_rounds} rondos!
outcome.draw: Say gawaen na laro et tie a {score_0}-{score_1} kaibat {num_rounds} rondos!
outcome.early_winner_alpha: Commander Alpha ya nanka {scores_0}-{scores_1} (nabangon so mayoria)!
outcome.early_winner_beta: Commander Beta ya nanka {scores_1}-{scores_0} (nabangon so mayoria)!
